opportunities.title: Authors' Contingency Fund

amount.raw: Grants range in value and are designed to meet immediate need.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Professional authors resident in the UK or British citizens (fiction writers, illustrators, literary translators, scriptwriters, poets, journalists and others) for whom author-related activities make up a substantial amount of annual income. Not open to editors, copywriters or salaried journalists. Authors must wait four full calendar years after a previous Contingency Fund grant before reapplying.
opportunities.summary: Small, short-term hardship grants to authors in financial difficulty, providing emergency relief for lost income, project shortfalls, illness impact, domestic changes or one-off expenses.

opportunities.title: Authors' Foundation
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Writers who have been previously published or have a contract for their project with a commercial UK/Irish publisher, or for script projects have had a work professionally performed or are under contract. Must have a non-contributory contract. Not open to editors, hybrid/self-published, or AI-generated works. Recipients must wait four years before re-applying.
opportunities.summary: Grants to help develop a work-in-progress (fiction, non-fiction, poetry and script projects), covering research, travel and other general expenditure. Applicants are automatically considered for specific named awards (Eric Ambler, Taner Baybars, John Brooks, Antonia Fraser, Arthur Welton, Great Britain Sasakawa).

opportunities.title: K Blundell Trust
opportunities.eligibility_summary: British authors under the age of 40 (on 1 March 2026), British by birth and currently resident in the UK, who have previously had a work of which they are the sole author published with a commercial UK publisher. Recipients must wait four years before re-applying.
opportunities.summary: Work-in-progress grants for British authors under 40 whose work aims to increase social awareness. Accepts fiction, non-fiction, poetry and script projects. Currently closed and will re-open for applications in 2027.

opportunities.title: Society of Authors' Access Fund

amount.raw: Small grants (usually £150 or less); applications over £150 accepted but may take longer to assess.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: All authors who create work for publication, broadcast or performance, meeting SoA membership criteria (membership not required). Open to UK and Irish residents and British and Irish citizens. One grant per calendar year.
opportunities.summary: Grants for travel, subsistence, childcare, carer or access needs for attending events, residencies and retreats. Currently closed and expected to re-open for applications in 2027.

opportunities.title: Strachey Trust Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to all authors (as defined by SoA Full Membership criteria, membership not required) who are UK resident or British citizens, working on a specific full-length literary project with a strong likelihood of publication. One application per calendar year; successful applicants must wait four years before re-applying.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable authors to travel to a UK or Republic of Ireland archive or collection to research manuscript material for a specific full-length literary project with a strong likelihood of publication.
